beta_slice.rationale: Sound integration architecture (single typed API seam, USE_MOCKS switch, server-only BFF, 1s polling with cleanup, error envelope); build+types green. Not live-ready until a bounded P0 set lands: USE_MOCKS hardcoded, BFF/DTO target older research-funding-mvp not v1.1, DataClassification/RunStatus model mismatch, no session/auth, no base_version/409, no 202 async.

full_contract.rationale: Beyond all beta P0s, ~21 structured-application/admin operations have zero UI (ProjectDates, WorkPackages, Milestones, PlannedHours, BudgetPlan, RiskRegister, ApplicationStructure, audit, controls, limits, final-quality-review). Net-new screens required; post-beta.

preconditions: treat v1.1 contract (hashes) as frozen for beta
FE-P0-01..09 landed before flipping USE_MOCKS live
beta_slice_frontend_integration.suggested_entry: cross-cutting P0-A..E + phases 1-2 behind a live flag

strengths: Single typed API seam (lib/api.ts) with one USE_MOCKS switch (line 54)
Server-only BFF; FASTAPI_BRIDGE_URL never reaches client; no NEXT_PUBLIC provider keys
Correct run-polling lifecycle: 1s interval, clearInterval on unmount and terminal states
German error envelope { error: { code, message } } with bridge-unreachable fallback
Approval/export gating derived from live blocker issues (no invented gate results)
Upload validation UX restricts to .txt/.md with rejection message
Mock issues model real Innosuisse beta-profile rules (char limit, 5% cash, 40-60% partner quota)

findings.title: USE_MOCKS hardcoded true
findings.current: USE_MOCKS=true short-circuits every API fn to mock data; fetch/BFF branch dead
findings.expected: A live path reachable so UI talks to BFF -> v1.1 backend
findings.user_impact: No screen connected to real data; closed demo
findings.fix: Replace constant with build/runtime toggle (server-trusted, no client secrets)

findings.title: Run start wrong path + sync instead of 202
findings.expected: createRun POST /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/runs returns 202 AsyncAccepted (operation_id+poll_url); 409/429/503; Idempotency-Key (openapi 937-956)
findings.user_impact: Cannot start run; no existing-run/cost/provider handling
findings.fix: Repath under project; consume 202 + poll; idempotency key; handle 409/429/503

findings.title: Review collapsed vs contract split
findings.expected: getReview + createHumanDecision + startTargetedRecheck(202) + createApproval(scope-bound); POST /runs/{id}/review does not exist (openapi 1372-1475, 2318)
findings.user_impact: Decisions/recheck/approval not performable; stale-approval unrepresentable
findings.fix: Split into 4 ops; recheck async; approval gated on current recheck scope

findings.title: Draft save no base_version_id / no 409
findings.expected: updateField PATCH /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/fields/{field_id}, DraftPatch with base_version_id, returns draft_version_id, 409 on conflict (openapi 1212-1251)
findings.user_impact: Silent overwrite on concurrent edits; no optimistic concurrency; recheck_required not surfaced
findings.fix: Repath run+field; send/track base_version_id; handle 409 reload-merge

findings.title: Export GET-binary vs POST async draft
findings.expected: createExport POST /runs/{id}/exports -> getExport -> downloadExport; DRAFT without valid approval (openapi 1473-1539)
findings.user_impact: Cannot create/track exports; draft-vs-final (approval) lost
findings.fix: create->poll->download; DRAFT watermark when approval absent/stale

findings.title: DataClassification flat enum vs 5-field object
findings.current: DataClass flat enum public_synthetic|public_external|internal|confidential|nda driving cloud/web gating
findings.expected: 5-field object sensitivity/origin/processing_mode/web_research_mode/nda_applies (openapi 2571-2605)
findings.user_impact: Intake cannot capture / run cannot transmit contract-valid classification
findings.fix: Replace flat enum with structured object end-to-end; derive gating from processing_mode/web_research_mode; trust server effective class

findings.title: RunStatus enum mismatch breaks polling
findings.expected: created|running|paused_for_review|completed|stopped|failed|cancelled (openapi 3344-3353)
findings.user_impact: paused_for_review not recognized (banner stuck), cancelled unhandled (poll never stops), created != queued
findings.fix: Adopt contract enum; map paused_for_review->review CTA, cancelled->stopped; drop queued/needs_review

findings.title: No session/authentication contract
findings.current: Mock login (no auth/session/guard); logout DropdownMenuItem has no onClick; no CSRF/cookie/401
findings.expected: createSession (cookie+CSRF), getSession/getCurrentUser, deleteSession; X-CSRF-Token on writes (openapi 2426); 401 everywhere
findings.user_impact: No auth; / reachable without login; logout no-op; no session-expiry UX
findings.fix: Real session layer; CSRF on writes; route guard; 401 re-login UX

findings.title: Integration mappers target research-funding-mvp not v1.1
findings.current: NODE_TO_STEP_INDEX keys on MVP node names; mapBackendRequirements reads requirement_matrix.eligibility_criteria/budget_rules + evidence_anchors
findings.expected: v1.1 current_stage enum (initialize..finalize_run, openapi 3356-3368); requirements from listRequirements
findings.user_impact: Backend stages render as 'Technischer Schritt'; requirements mapping mismatches live data
findings.fix: Rekey node/stage map to current_stage; rewrite requirements mapper vs listRequirements schema

findings.title: No 202/operation_id/poll_url async handling
findings.current: mock run engine polls getRun directly; no AsyncOperation concept
findings.expected: createRun/createRedraft/recheck/export return 202 AsyncAccepted; poll via getOperation (openapi 3425-3457)
findings.user_impact: Async work not tracked/cancelled correctly
findings.fix: Generic operation-poller; route async ops through it

findings.title: No EvidenceLink / verification_status model
findings.expected: EvidenceAnchor + EvidenceLink (active|stale|removed) + verification_status; create/delete links (openapi 1296-1341)
findings.user_impact: Cannot link/unlink evidence or reflect stale/removed links
findings.fix: Add EvidenceLink DTO + link/unlink + link status rendering

findings.title: No CSRF token / idempotency key on writes
findings.expected: X-CSRF-Token + Idempotency-Key on mutating calls (openapi 2426, 2433)
findings.user_impact: Writes rejected (CSRF) or duplicated on retry
findings.fix: Inject CSRF from session + generated idempotency key on writes

findings.title: Source lifecycle incomplete
findings.current: status processed|processing|error; remove local-only; upload fakes completion via setTimeout(1500)
findings.expected: status incl. needs_manual_input (openapi 2819); list/poll/delete sources
findings.user_impact: Manual-input sources invisible; deletes not persisted; processing cosmetic
findings.fix: Adopt contract status; wire list/poll/delete; real status polling

findings.title: Capabilities/role/service not server-driven
findings.current: role hardcoded; service availability from local scenario flags
findings.expected: getCapabilities/getServiceAvailability provide effective_role + KI/web; UI follows server (openapi 2538, 2507)
findings.user_impact: UI role gating can disagree with server
findings.fix: Fetch capabilities post-login; drive gating from them

findings.title: Failure/edge states not handled
findings.current: errors collapse to one German message
findings.expected: distinct 409 existing-run / 429 cost / 503 provider / policy-blocked / parsing-failure / stale-approval / recheck-in-progress (openapi 949-956)
findings.user_impact: Cannot distinguish try-later vs cost-limit vs policy-blocked
findings.fix: Map contract error codes/status to distinct UI states

findings.title: Text/URL sources unsupported in UI
findings.expected: createTextSource + importUrlSource with URL/research confirmation UX
findings.user_impact: Two contract source types unusable from UI
findings.fix: Add text/URL source entry + URL confirmation (confirm if deliberate beta cut)

findings.title: No functioning lint, no automated tests
findings.current: lint: eslint . (eslint absent); zero unit/E2E; frozen install needs non-TTY consent
findings.expected: green lint + minimal tests for contract-critical mapping
findings.user_impact: Integration regressions uncaught; CI not reproducible
findings.fix: Add eslint (config+dep) + small unit suite; set confirmModulesPurge=false/CI

findings.title: Multiple competing status vocabularies
findings.expected: UI states derived from contract enums via one mapping module
findings.user_impact: Drift between UI and contract states (second source of truth)
findings.fix: Single contract->UI mapping; keep presentational enums separate

findings.title: Hardcoded single project p1
findings.expected: listProjects/getProject; real active project id
findings.user_impact: Single hardcoded project; needed for createRun path
findings.fix: Load projects; resolve active id from context

findings.title: Fake cost values
findings.expected: getUsage / estimated_cost_chf (openapi 3392)
findings.user_impact: Cost banner cosmetic until wired
findings.fix: Source cost from run status/usage

findings.title: Frozen install needs non-TTY purge consent
findings.expected: reproducible non-interactive install
findings.user_impact: CI install fails without flag
findings.fix: Set CI=true / confirmModulesPurge=false; document in README
